name: session_list
description: List sessions in the session store, newest activity first. Read-only: never mutates session data. Use to discover which sessions exist (ids, titles, first prompts) before session_read / session_search.
first_use_guidance:
Guidance for later session_list calls in this turn:
- The footer reports only how many sessions were shown, never the store total or the number of matches, so a truncated list can look complete. Widen `limit` (max 100) or narrow it with `query` when the list looks short.

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to list (default 20, max 100; 0 lists nothing and returns `No sessions found.`).

query.description: Optional substring filter on session id, title, or first user prompt (case-insensitive).
